name: Kalki
note: Suspended: an avatar with no ancestry, anchored below the whole tree because nothing comes after him

Kalki.note: The twenty-second and last: to be born to Vishnu Yasha in the village of Shambhala at the joint of two ages, when the kings have all turned to plunder, and to ride out on a white horse with a sword like a comet. The only avatar in this tree who has not happened, and the reason his anchor is "last" rather than a row: nothing comes after him, however far the tree grows. SB 1.3.25, 12.2
